requirements_assurance: Checked Volume 1 (pp. 3-12) for scope, deliverables, evaluation criteria, submission method and timetable; Volume 4 (pp. 2-13) for Appendices A-E and the PSQ; and Volume 4 Schedule 1 (pp. 15-16) for contract particulars. The response set maps to those documents as follows: technical narrative addresses T1-T3 and T5-T7; social value response addresses S10-S11; Appendix A, B, C and E are drafted as returnable forms; Appendix D is completed as a nil reserved-information return; pricing is treated as a separate attachment for C8, with C9 covered in the commercial schedule; contract particulars are populated to support human review and award processing.
